x-test.purpose: A read-only tool whose results are bounded by the caller's own input. Under v0.2 a tool of this shape failed all three Bounded Output checks and the conflict-kind check despite being correct; under v0.3 it is fully conformant with no pagination, no --fields and no conflict kind. This is the fixture that pins the narrowed Principle 6.

name: whatport
description: Find the process listening on a port.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Show the listeners on a port.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List every listening socket on this machine.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print this clispec contract as JSON.

errors.description: Nothing is listening on that port.
